title: Geotech Reference Chapter
description: Schema for structured chapter text JSON files used by geotech_references._retrieval. Mirrors the format established by gec_7/text/chapterNN.json.

volume.description: Volume number for multi-volume references; null if single-volume.

chapter.description: Chapter number. For prologue or front-matter, use 0.

section_id.description: Hierarchical section identifier. FHWA/GEC dot form ('5.7.2', '7.2.1.3.1'), UFC hyphen-then-dot form ('4-1', '4-2.1.1'), or prologue ('P.1', 'P-1').

summary.description: 300-500 char summary of the section's content, returned by default from reference_search. Engineers and agents get this compact version first; the full body is only loaded via reference_get when they commit to reading a specific section.

body.description: Long-form narrative text from the source document. Container sections (whose children appear later in the same chapter) may legitimately have empty bodies.

id.description: Equation label as it appears in the source (e.g., 'Eq. 5-12').

implemented_in.description: Dotted path to the digitized Python function (e.g., 'dm7_1.chapter5.primary_consolidation_settlement_nc'), or null if not yet digitized.

oneOf.description: String summary form (legacy, used by gec_12 deep subsections).

items.description: Figure reference and caption (e.g., 'Figure 5-3: Compression curve construction').

applicability.description: One-sentence description of when this section applies.

subsections.description: Optional nested subsections following the same schema (used by gec_12 for deep hierarchies).
